rows.dek_lead: Are movie critics so hammered by absurd plots that they can’t see how truly, profoundly weird “Ghost Dog” is? The reviews treat it matter of factly: Yeah, here’s this hit man, he lives like a samurai, he gets his instructions by pigeon, bla
